title: Jimmy Corsetti's theory that Atlantis was the Richat Structure
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Jimmy Corsetti's theory that Atlantis was the Richat Structure, about unspecified at Richat Structure, Mauritania, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: presented a theory that uh maybe Atlantis existed in the the richot territory

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, mentions a theory put forward by a man named Jimmy Corsetti, apparently on the show of another podcast host, Joe Rogan. According to Michels, Corsetti suggested that Atlantis, the legendary sunken civilization, may have been located at the Richat Structure, a huge ring-shaped landform in the desert of Mauritania in West Africa. If true, it would place a lost advanced civilization at a real spot on the map.
